title: NoiseRater: Meta-Learned Noise Valuation for Diffusion Model Training
abstract: arXiv:2605.08144v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Training a diffusion model involves two sources of randomness for each data sample: the timestep and the Gaussian noise realization. The timestep has been studied extensively through scheduling and weighting, whereas the impact of the noise realization at a given timestep is still underexplored. In this work, we examine whether different noise instances are equally informative. We introduce NoiseRater, a network that scores an individual noise instance conditioned on the data sample and timestep. The rater is learned through bilevel optimization, where its scores reweight the diffusion loss in the inner loop, and it is updated to reduce validation loss after the inner-loop updates. Using the trained rater to select training noise, we observe three properties of training noise. translated_title: NoiseRater：面向扩散模型训练的元学习噪声评估方法
translated_abstract: 训练扩散模型时，每个数据样本涉及两个随机性来源：时间步和高斯噪声的具体实现。时间步已通过调度与加权等方式得到广泛研究，而给定时间步下噪声实现的影响却仍未被充分探索。在这项工作中，我们研究了不同的噪声实例是否具有同等的信息量。我们提出了NoiseRater，这是一个在给定数据样本和时间步的条件下对单个噪声实例进行打分的网络。该评估器通过双层优化进行学习：其打分在内循环中对扩散损失进行重新加权，而在内循环更新之后，评估器通过降低验证损失来进一步更新。利用训练好的评估器来选择训练噪声，我们观察到训练噪声的三个特性。首先，同一时间步的噪声实现并非同等有用：评估器给出的最高分噪声相比独立同分布采样能带来性能提升，而其…
tldr: 提出NoiseRater，一种通过双层元学习对给定样本和时间步条件下的噪声实例进行评分的模型，用于选择更有信息量的训练噪声，并发现同一时间步的不同噪声实现并非同等有用。
en_tdlr: NoiseRater is a meta-learned network trained via bilevel optimization that scores noise instances conditioned on data and timestep, enabling noise selection for diffusion training and revealing that noise realizations at the same timestep are not equally informative.
